name: @nialtoservices/freescout-mcp
description: A stdio MCP server that provides access to FreeScout via the API module.
author: Toby Herbert

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --keep-names --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/freescout-mcp.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
